title: Simonian Cuckoos
content:
[[File:'Nandina_and_Rooster'_from_the_'Colorful_Realm_of_Living_Beings'_by_Ito_Jakuchu.jpg|thumb|400px|Itō Jakuchū]]Simonian Cuckoos are [[chickens]] descended from [[Simone the Fowl]]. Despite the name, they are not related to [[cuckoos]]. Simone the Fowl was also a cuckoo chicken, so there may be other cuckoo chicken breeds.
